about: Hunter step 4's deadfall kebbits, where live has them, by the boulders: wild kebbits in the Piscatoris Hunter area and Auburnvale, barb-tailed kebbits in the Feldip Hunter area, prickly kebbits in the Piscatoris Hunter area, sabre-toothed kebbits in the Rellekka Hunter area. Each tile and type is the kebbit's OSRS Wiki page (its location table). Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: pyre foxes (Varlamore) and maniacal monkeys (Monkey Madness II's lab).
